project.name: Vidulum Bank Data AI Categorization API
project.description:
CONTRACT: what another module may ask of AI categorization. No Spring, no AI library, no implementation - a consumer compiles against this and never sees a prompt, a model or a pattern document.
Two methods, both derived from real call sites rather than from the engine's surface: suggestFor() from AiCategorizeCommandHandler, and matchLearned() from the two staging handlers that were applying learned patterns with their own copy of the matching rule.
Depends on cashflow-api for Type (INFLOW/OUTFLOW), which is the whole family's vocabulary; duplicating it would be worse than a contract-to-contract dependency, and both are leaves.
The analysis behind it: docs/features-backlog/2026-10-22-ai-categorization-module-split.md.
